$comment: Arche UI design-rules registry (post-Brief #6). Single source of truth for the Shapeshift rulebook. tier 'teach' statements are injected into the generation model's instructions (generated at runtime — never hand-maintain a second copy in a prompt string). tier 'enforce' rules are deterministic validator checks with the numbers in params. Rule ids are permanent once shipped. Color budgets are Arche's own (see CALIBRATION.md); WCAG 2.2 AA stays absolute and unchanged.

rules.statement: Role rules for 12-step color scales: backgrounds are steps 1-2 (near-neutral tints of the hue, never the hue at strength); only steps 9-10 may be strongly saturated; text is steps 11-12; borders (steps 6-8) carry little chroma.

One primary hue family plus at most one accent hue family, plus fixed semantic hues (success/warning/destructive bands are Arche-defined and never model-chosen). Neutrals are a tinted gray scale, not a second color.
Neutrals are tinted toward the primary hue at very low chroma (OKLCH C approx 0.005-0.015); never mix warm and cool grays in one identity; never pure #000 or #fff for text/background tokens.
Dark mode is built from the scale's dark steps (structural tone steps), not by desaturating or inverting light values.

Avoid generic-AI color defaults: purple-to-blue gradient palettes, glowing cyan-on-near-black, a rainbow chart set, a different hue per surface, saturation used to create hierarchy (hierarchy comes from lightness steps).
No eyebrow label above every heading — eyebrows are rare seasoning, never the default section opener.
No tracked-out uppercase micro-labels as a texture; labels look designed only when rare.
At most one coloured word per headline, and only the focal word the accent placement names — never a decorative rainbow word.
The hero must own its first viewport: headline, proof, and one CTA visible without scrolling on desktop.
No email capture at the end of every page — one newsletter moment per site at most, and only where the genre recipe allows it.
Never ship the untouched default look: if radius, shadows, motion, and type read as stock shadcn, the identity failed to land.
No three feature cards in a row by default — vary the rhythm (bento, split, editorial) unless the genre recipe asks for the grid.
No generic 3-tier pricing with a highlighted middle column unless the product's pricing story earns it; comparison beats decoration.

The accent hue family must contrast with the base pair — accent overlapping the primary family is predictable and scores low; the compiler reports the surprise score (enterprise monochrome-by-design is exempt).
Spend the accent in exactly two places: the primary CTA and the focal word. Never on backgrounds, body text, or borders.
Every generated palette's colors carry evocative names (Sakura Pink, Neon Pear) persisted into payload metadata and shown in Studio — never bare hexes in the user-facing surface.

Every generated identity lands on exactly one art direction from the closed registry (selected from DNA by the compiler, never by the model); the direction is stored on the identity and shown in Studio.
Fix in this order and stop at the first failing layer: layout, contrast, typography, spacing/clutter, accent, decoration last. Never decorate a broken layout.
Full-bleed imagery over filler stock: product-as-background and photo-forward cards beat decorative thumbnails; boring stock is a website killer.
Imagery treatment derives from the identity: duotone or tint from the palette so photography reads as the brand's, not the stock site's.
Grain overlay 0.04-0.08 opacity via SVG feTurbulence over neutral surfaces — never a baked grain hero image.
Headline discipline: 11 words max — a checkable block standard, not a suggestion.
Background-family tokens stay near-neutral: chroma capped per mode and profile.
Text tokens stay readable and quiet: chroma capped.
Structural tokens stay quiet: chroma capped.
Solid action tokens carry the chroma voice: a floor that scales with the chroma axis (washed-out primaries fail only when the DNA asks for vivid) and a profile-scaled ceiling.
Chroma tapers as lightness approaches extremes: very light or very dark tokens must be near-neutral (high chroma is not available at extreme lightness; values claiming it clip and shift hue).
Neutral tokens are tinted toward the primary hue, unless the identity is an explicitly neutral/monochrome selection.
Chart colors are mutually distinguishable: pairwise OKLCH separation floor, and hues closer than the hue floor must be lightness-separated.

Body 400-500, headings 600-700; display may use the selected font's heaviest weight only in the expressive profile; never synthesize weights the font registry entry doesn't list (the validator enforces the listed weights).
Body copy measure is 65-75 characters (a component concern for prose surfaces, not a token).
Every emitted text size equals a derived type-scale step; the scale id must be a closed-registry entry; no free sizes anywhere in a generated payload.
Emitted line heights stay in role bands: display 1.0-1.15, headings 1.15-1.3, body 1.45-1.65, labels 1.2-1.4.
Display size is capped per profile multiple of body size and absolutely.
Nested surfaces follow outer radius = inner radius + gap (see container component Standards).
The --border-width a generated payload may carry is bounded per profile; hand-authored payloads may use any legal contract value (0-3px).
The --radius base a generated payload may carry is bounded per profile; the sharpness axis maps inside the bound, never past it.
Spacing derives from a 4px sub-grid / 8px base grid; density selects among existing component knob options only (no new spacing tokens).
Generated motion token durations stay within component-transition bounds; easings come only from the closed motion set; respectReducedMotion stays fixed true.
One job per section: a block does exactly what its manifest purpose says — no pricing tables inside feature grids, no second CTAs in footers.

A page has exactly one h1 (the hero or the app view title carries it); every block declares its heading role and landmark in its manifest composition, and landmark semantics come from the template, never the consumer.
Compose only through a block's typed content slots; never pass untyped free-form children where a slot exists, and never restyle a block's internals — style is the identity's job.
